subject: P0 MANAGER DISPOSITION: preserve early WakeInner; implement attempt-correlated downstream causal chain now
body: Current source already emits WakeInner from onEarlyOpeningEdge, so moving the wake trigger earlier is not evidence-backed. The actionable P0 fix contract is an isolated Cycle-2 candidate that carries one openingAttemptId/presentation-attempt identity from the accepted opening edge through Binder/physical wake, logical display discovery/state, first Choreographer/frame/transaction/expected-present, FIRST_USEFUL and FIRST_INTERACTIVE. Use sparse causal-ledger state changes plus existing Transition Lab high-rate data; diagnostics must never become semantic/routing/privacy/readiness authority. Add stale-generation, duplicate-wake, reversal, privilege-loss, logical-before-Binder-return, physical-success-without-logical, useful-vs-interactive and 30-70 oscillation tests. Disposition remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE until physical Fold7 traces localize and then measurably reduce edge-to-useful/interactivity latency without regressions.
